packageRules.description: vitest is pinned twice (manifest + pnpm-workspace overrides); Renovate would move the manifest range without the override and split test state. Keep it on the manual path so both places move by hand (ADR 001 caveat).
Patch-level bumps (non pre-1.0) group into one weekly PR and automerge once CI is green.
Pre-1.0 packages: SemVer patch can still break, so do not automerge them even in the patch group.
Minor updates group into a separate weekly PR, worth a skim, never automerged.
Keep the pinned pnpm package manager itself on the latest stable within its own weekly PR, not merged with dependency bumps.
